SECOND TAKEAbout

There’s a person on the other side of every failure.

SECOND TAKE is an interview publication about what leaders chose after the first attempt went wrong. We don’t retell the road to success. We record the time they couldn’t decide — and the moment they did.

00:00:00:00About

PrinciplesHow we work

  1. 01

    No redemption arcs

    We ask about the doubt before it became a story of overcoming.

  2. 02

    Numbers and feelings, equally

    The facts of revenue and cash carry the same weight as what it felt like at the time.

  3. 03

    In their own words

    Minimal editing. Every story is recorded twice: in print and in voice.

FormatPrint and voice

Side AThe article
One leader, one decision, told as a long-form interview in four scenes.
Side BThe voice
The same story in the guest’s own voice, as a podcast. Coming soon.
In briefThree lines
For busy days, every story opens with the decision in three lines.
